jobs.occupation: Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (w/m/d) (Unternehmensberater/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (f/m/d) to join our** Consulting (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/consulting-solutions) **division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You translate executive business priorities into cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI transformation roadmaps and help clients define their future business and operating models.Transformation – You develop business cases, target operating models and transformation blueprints, while driving process redesign and operating model transformation enabled by Agentic AI.Growth – You collaborate with technical teams to define integrated end-to-end cloud and AI solutions and drive strategic AWS pursuits.Leadership – You shape compelling AWS and AI transformation narratives for C-level stakeholders, influence strategic decision-making, build trusted executive relationships and drive business-led transformation from strategy to execution.Your profile- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Technology Management, Computer Science, or a comparable field.- You bring 6-10 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, business transformation, and/or technology strategy, including the development of business cases, operating models and executive-level programs.- You possess deep AWS expertise combined with strong executive advisory capabilities and can translate complex business requirements across cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI into scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.- You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, driving strategic initiatives from initial concept through implementation and orchestrating collaboration across business and technology teams.- You communicate confidently in English and German, combine a collaborative and hands-on approach with a strong enthusiasm for GenAI and emerging technologies to turn innovative ideas into tangible client value.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Family – Working parents bring huge value to our firm and we want to ensure that they are supported at every stage and feel confident balancing their work and home lives. Also, we support you, If required, in caring for relatives by arranging carers, special leave or part-time models.Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime in your flex-time account and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. A partial payout is possible once a year. We will be happy to discuss the exact details with you in a personal meeting. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups andAnd there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our Experience Consulting team, you will accompany our clients on the way to a new or improved digital product with designs, concepts and qualitative user research. We combine design thinking methods with collaborative workshop formats to involve as many stakeholders as possible from brainstorming to go-live. Help us to leverage the growth potential of our clients in the digital world!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Felix Baumecker at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Specialist– Microscopy Solutions (Mikroskopielösungen) (m/w/d) (Mikrotechnologe/-technologin)
jobs.description: Company:CSR Biotech (www.csr-biotech.eu (http://www.csr-biotech.com/) )Contract:Permanent, Full-time (100%)Location:CSR Biotech Europe Headquarters in Heidelberg, Germany.Company Description:At CSR Biotech, we are committed to advancing the frontiers of scientific and medical innovation.We are growing rapidly in Europe, with our Heidelberg office playing a key role in our global expansion. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing company and make a significant impact in the life sciences imaging market.About the RoleAs an Inside Sales Specialist, you are the engine behind our sales team. You turn customer requirements into winning proposals, keep every order moving smoothly from quote to delivery, and ensure our sales team have the information and support they need to close deals.What You’ll Do- Create tailored quotations based on specific customer requirements, working closely with Sales and Product Management- Prepare public tender submissions for complex microscopy systems- Maintaining a library of reusable tender documents, certifications and references- Own our internal price list and configuration database, keeping it accurate and up to date- Coordinate internal scheduling for field visits, conferences and product demonstrations- Manage the full order lifecycle, from processing customer orders to coordinating end-to-end fulfilment- Safeguard CRM data quality, continuously improving the completeness and accuracy of our records- Monitor service contracts, warranty claims and repairs, and spot opportunities for upselling- Support sales campaigns, product launches, customer events and trade fairsWho You Are- Experience with public procurement processes in Europe, ideally in the sale of complex capital equipment- A BSc or higher in engineering, life sciences or a related field- Exceptional attention to detail and a structured way of working- A proactive, self-starting mindset: you spot what needs doing and take ownership- Strong communication skills: you will be in daily close contact with customers as well as each member of our team.- Fluent written and spoken English; knowledge of German or Chinese is a plusWhat We Offer- A dynamic, international work environment with a lot of room to grow- The opportunity to be a key team member in a growing Global Operations Hub- Close collaboration with international teams and exciting tech projects- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.- Paid annual leave of 30 working days per year.About CSR Europe GmbHCSR Biotech is a technology-driven company focused on advancing how we observe, understand, and interact with living systems.Founded in 2019, our roots trace back to the interdisciplinary labs of Peking University, where our founding team worked alongside leading scientists in biological imaging. Since then, we have grown into a global organization, with our headquarters in Guangzhou and our European hub in Heidelberg, Germany — which is rapidly evolving into our global commercial center and a key engine for international growth.Today, CSR Biotech brings together a team of over 150 scientists, engineers, and innovators, supported by a 4,000 m² facility that integrates research, development, and manufacturing. Our infrastructure includes advanced imaging laboratories, cell culture facilities, and a high-performance computing platform capable of handling PB-scale live-cell data.We are growing rapidly globally, this is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing company and make a significant impact in the life sciences imaging market.Vertrag: Fest, Vollzeit (100 %)Standort: Hauptsitz von CSR Biotech Europe in Heidelberg, Deutschland.Unternehmensbeschreibung: Bei CSR Biotech engagieren wir uns dafür, die Grenzen wissenschaftlicher und medizinischer Innovationen zu erweitern.Wir wachsen rasant in Europa, wobei unsere Niederlassung in Heidelberg eine zentrale Rolle bei unserer globalen Ausweitung spielt. Dies ist eine spannende Gelegenheit, einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen beizutreten und einen bedeutenden Beitrag auf dem Markt für Bildgebungsverfahren in den Lebenswissenschaften zu leisten.Über die Rolle:Als Inside Sales Spezialist sind Sie die treibende Kraft unseres Vertriebsteams. Sie verwandeln Kundenanforderungen in überzeugende Angebote, sorgen dafür, dass jeder Auftrag von der Angebotsstellung bis zur Lieferung reibungslos verläuft, und stellen sicher, dass unser Vertriebsteam die notwendigen Informationen und Unterstützung erhält, um Abschlüsse zu erzielen.Was Sie tun werden:Erstellen Sie maßgeschneiderte Angebote basierend auf spezifischen Kundenanforderungen und arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Vertrieb und dem Produktmanagement zusammen.Bereiten Sie Angebotsunterlagen für komplexe Mikroskopiesysteme vor.Pflegung einer Bibliothek wiederverwendbarer Ausschreibungsunterlagen, -zertifikate und -zeugnisseWir besitzen unsere interne Preisliste und Konfigurationsdatenbank und halten sie genau und auf dem neuesten Stand.Koordinieren Sie die interne Terminplanung für Vor-Ort-Besuche, Konferenzen und ProduktpräsentationenVerwalten Sie den gesamten Bestelllebenszyklus, von der Bearbeitung von Kundenbestellungen bis zur Koordination der vollständigen Auftragsabwicklung.Sichern Sie die CRM-Datenqualität und verbessern Sie kontinuierlich die Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit unserer Aufzeichnungen.Überwachen Sie Serviceverträge, Gewährleistungsansprüche und Reparaturen und erkennen Sie Chancen für Up-Selling.Unterstützung von Verkaufskampagnen, Produkteinführungen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Messen.Wer Sie sind:Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Beschaffungsverfahren in Europa, idealerweise im Verkauf von komplexen Kapitalgütern.Ein BSc oder höher in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biowissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich.Ausgeprägte Aufmerksamkeit für Details und eine strukturierte ArbeitsweiseEine proaktive, selbstinitiierte Denkweise: Sie erkennen, was getan werden muss, und übernehmen Verantwortung.Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Sie stehen täglich in engem Kontakt mit Kunden sowie mit jedem Mitglied unseres Teams.Fließendes schriftliches und gesprochenes Englisch; Kenntnisse in Deutsch oder Chinesisch sind ein Plus.Was wir anbieten:Ein dynamisches, internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für Wachstum.Die Möglichkeit, ein Schlüsselmitglied eines wachsenden Global Operations Hubs zu seinEnge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams und spannende TechnologieprojekteWettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und leistungsbezogene Boni.Bezahlter Jahresurlaub von 30 Arbeitstagen pro Jahr.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Vertrieb

As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionJoin our Medicinal Chemistry Department and help us explore the full potential of NMR in drug discovery.As an NMR Specialist, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, providing structural insights into protein-ligand complexes and supporting projects with NMR-based screening data. Using our state-of-the-art facilities, you will have the opportunity to develop and apply innovative NMR approaches and contribute directly to advancing our drug discovery projects.We are looking for someone who combines scientific curiosity with agility, accountability and an entrepreneurial mindset, and who enjoys working collaboratively to turn new ideas into meaningful scientific impact.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is limited for 2 years.Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc".
